notes:
- **Send to your apps (Pro).** A new **Share** button opens **Windows' own Share sheet** on a capture, so any app that accepts shares is one click away: mail, chat, team apps, nearby sharing. It is on the **confirmation note** (next to **Edit**, and next to **Save as GIF** and **Show in folder** on a recording's note), in the **strip** (press **H**, or right-click a card and choose **Share…**; several picked captures go together), and in the **editor's top bar** (a changed picture is saved over the capture, as **Done** does, then the saved file is shared; with nothing changed the capture is shared as it is; the editor stays open). A picture goes as a file and, for apps that take pictures, as the picture itself; a recording or GIF goes as a file. Windows already shows the apps you used last at the top of the sheet, and **Email** is among its targets, so A9 Snap keeps no list of its own.
- **Nothing leaves A9 Snap by itself:** no account, no connection and no network call. A9 Snap gives Windows the file and the app you pick takes it from there. A secure capture has no Share button. Without Pro the buttons carry a **PRO** badge and open the Pro sheet. The Pro features page lists **Send to your apps** as **Included** with how to use it. New manual page **Share to your apps**; Keyboard shortcuts, the strip, the editor, Pro features and Privacy cover it. The log says how many files, never a name.
